stories.headline: Felipe VI acknowledges 'abuse' in Spanish conquest of Americas, diplomatic opening with Mexico
stories.summary: King Felipe VI made unprecedented comments acknowledging 'much abuse' during Spain's conquest of the Americas, speaking to Mexico's ambassador during a museum visit. Mexico's President Sheinbaum welcomed the gesture and invited Felipe VI to the World Cup. The remarks sparked political debate in Spain with government support and PP criticism.

stories.headline: Government coalition crisis as Sumar blocks Cabinet meeting over economic measures
stories.summary: Sumar ministers refused to enter a Cabinet meeting for two hours in protest over disagreements with Sánchez's economic response package to the Iran war. The crisis was resolved after last-minute negotiations, with Sánchez making concessions to his coalition partners.

stories.headline: Vox internal rebellion erupts with corruption accusations against Santiago Abascal
stories.summary: Multiple Vox figures including expelled leaders García-Gallardo and Espinosa de los Monteros launched attacks on party leader Santiago Abascal, alleging financial improprieties and demanding an extraordinary party congress. García-Gallardo specifically accused Abascal of enriching himself through payments to his wife.

stories.headline: Parliamentary battles over economic response to Iran war escalation
stories.summary: Sánchez and Feijóo clashed in Congress over the government's economic measures responding to the Iran war. The PP warned against supporting an 'omnibus' decree while Sánchez accused the opposition of being 'pro-war' if they reject the aid package. The decree includes 5 billion euros in tax cuts and social measures.

stories.headline: Zelenski visits Spain for cooperation agreements and King Felipe VI audience
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenski made his fourth visit to Spain since the Russian invasion, signing cooperation agreements with Sánchez at Moncloa, meeting with congressional leadership, and having an audience with King Felipe VI at Zarzuela. The visit came 24 hours before the EU Council summit on the Iran war.

articles.title: Sánchez utilizará la foto con Zelenski, 24 horas antes de la cumbre de la UE, para avalar su 'no a la guerra' ante los socios

stories.headline: Felipe VI attends Vatican audience with Pope Leo XIV and Formula E race in Madrid
stories.summary: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia held their first official audience with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican, followed by Felipe VI becoming protocanon of Santa María la Mayor basilica. The King also attended the first Formula E race held in Madrid at the Jarama circuit with regional president Díaz Ayuso.
